title: Decision Log
description: Append-only decisions with provenance, supersession, retrieval, and audited MCP actions.
summary: Append-only decisions with provenance, supersession, retrieval, and audited MCP actions.
offersHint: Append-only decisions with provenance, supersession, retrieval, and audited MCP actions. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.decisionlog.ai/api/mcp · Requires headers: x-mcp-client-id, Authorization

headers.name: x-mcp-client-id
headers.description: Registered Decision Log MCP client identifier.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer authentication using the registered MCP client secret.

variables.name: mcp_client_secret
variables.description: Registered Decision Log MCP client secret.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer authentication using the registered MCP client secret.

variables.name: mcp_client_secret
variables.description: Registered Decision Log MCP client secret.

headerDocs.name: x-mcp-client-id
headerDocs.description: Registered Decision Log MCP client identifier.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_create_decision
toolsPreview.description: Create an immutable Decision when permitted, otherwise create a reviewable DecisionCandidate.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_search_decisions
toolsPreview.description: Search decisions in the authenticated workspace.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_get_decision
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve one decision by ID.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_supersede_decision
toolsPreview.description: Create a replacement Decision and supersession relationship for an existing Decision.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_lock_decision
toolsPreview.description: Irreversibly prevent a current Decision from ever being superseded; may create an approval request.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_approve_decision_action
toolsPreview.description: Record one immutable approval or rejection attestation.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_get_decision_governance
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve lock, authority snapshot, and approval state for a Decision.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_list_recent_decisions
toolsPreview.description: List the most recent decisions in the authenticated workspace.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_submit_source
toolsPreview.description: Submit source content for ingestion and later provenance links.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_list_sources
toolsPreview.description: List visible SourceContent using bounded excerpts and canonical retention redaction.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_get_source
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve one visible SourceContent detail projection. Redacted, purged, and unknown retention states never return stored title, content, blob URL, or metadata.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_get_source_decisions
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve visible DecisionSource links for one SourceContent record with each linked Decision's lifecycle, authoritative current-state, and supersession identity.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_list_candidates
toolsPreview.description: List reviewable DecisionCandidates visible in the current Organization and Workspace before taking a resolution action.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_get_candidate
toolsPreview.description: Get the complete visible review context for one DecisionCandidate before approving, rejecting, or converting it.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_create_candidate
toolsPreview.description: Create a reviewable DecisionCandidate.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_resolve_candidate
toolsPreview.description: Approve or reject a pending DecisionCandidate.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_convert_candidate_to_supersession
toolsPreview.description: Approve a pending DecisionCandidate as the immutable replacement for one current Decision, preserving provenance and supersession history.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_get_current_decision
toolsPreview.description: Get the newest active decision in a domain.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_get_supersession_history
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the complete visible Decision supersession chain in oldest-to-newest order. Malformed chains fail closed and never claim a current Decision.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_get_decision_sources
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve retention-safe provenance links for one visible Decision, including relationship, source lifecycle, and submitter metadata.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_list_audit_events
toolsPreview.description: List the visible append-only audit events for the current Organization using the canonical permission-aware, attribution-safe projection.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_list_decisions_by_tag
toolsPreview.description: List decisions related to an exact tag slug.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_list_decisions_by_domain
toolsPreview.description: List decisions related to an exact domain slug.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_render_decision
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user wants to inspect one known Decision in a visual card. Call a data retrieval tool first when the Decision ID is unknown.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_render_workspace_brief
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user wants a visual briefing of recent decisions, pending candidates, and source activity.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_render_decision_explorer
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user wants to browse the five most recent Decisions and optionally inspect one in detail.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_render_candidate_review
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user wants to inspect and disposition one known DecisionCandidate in a visual review workbench.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_render_supersession_composer
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user has a known active Decision and complete replacement meaning to review before supersession.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_render_source_pipeline
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user wants to inspect one known source, its provenance lifecycle, and extracted candidates.

toolsPreview.name: decision_log_render_audit_explorer
toolsPreview.description: Use this when the user wants to visually inspect attributable, append-only audit events with filtering and pagination.
